description: Prices sending USDC, USDT or USDG from a wallet without gas (no ETH, POL, AVAX, BNB, SOL or TRX) to another address, e.g. an exchange deposit or another wallet. Use quote_swap instead when the user wants gas in the same wallet. Creates a free quote, valid for 10 minutes; nothing moves on chain until the wallet signs it. Returns { summary, transfer }: the transfer id, network and service fee, what the recipient gets (net) and status "quoted". Show the summary to the user and get approval before signing. Fails with a readable error when the amount is outside $2 to $1,000 (Tron: from $10), the wallet holds too little, the token is frozen, or the wallet sent 10 transfers in 24 hours.

amount.description: Amount of the token, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "12.5". Fees come out of it.

recipient.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

sender.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

token.description: Stablecoin symbol, e.g. "USDC", "USDC.e", "USDT", "USDT0", "USDG", "USD1" or "FDUSD". gasrescue_info lists what each chain supports.

name: quote_send
title: Quote a send without gas
